implementation_notes.offline_strategy: Bundle versioned JSON files in app assets; import to SQLite/Room or load as read-only catalog, with user builds and inventory stored locally.
implementation_notes.api_strategy: Do not require a live API for core browsing. Optional online refresh can fetch a community dataset only with explicit user action, version/hash tracking, validation, and fallback to bundled JSON.
implementation_notes.licensing: Monster Hunter is Capcom IP. Community repositories do not imply that official artwork or game assets may be redistributed. Audit licenses for code, datasets, and images separately. Prefer user-supplied/local images or original generic art if asset rights are unclear.
implementation_notes.accuracy: Monster weakness stars and hitzones can differ by body part, state, quest/rank and game version. Model weakness by element + part + condition instead of a single global weakness where data allows.
